description: Landing Page Prompt Generator — backend API that synthesizes all agent conversations into a vibe-coding prompt, plus a gated frontend button + modal that lets students copy/download the generated prompt once all TM and VD milestones are complete.

userStories.title: Create system prompt module for landing page synthesis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-only module that exports the Gemini system prompt instructing it to synthesize agent conversations into a structured vibe-coding brief.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/landing-prompt/system-prompt.ts
File starts with `import 'server-only'`
Exports a single constant: `export const LANDING_PROMPT_SYSTEM: string`
System prompt instructs Gemini to parse messages prefixed with [TREND-MAPPER], [VALUE-DESIGNER], [SPI]
System prompt specifies exactly 7 output sections: Venture Overview, Target User, Core Value Proposition, Page Sections & Copy Guidance, Feature List, Design Aesthetic, Technical Scaffold
System prompt includes instruction to keep output under 2000 words
System prompt references Bolt, Lovable, Cursor, and v0 as target vibe-coding tools
System prompt instructs to use placeholder text (e.g. [Missing: ...]) for any missing information
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create POST /api/landing-prompt/[projectId] route handler
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API route that loads all project messages from the DB, labels them by agent, calls Gemini, and returns the generated prompt as JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/api/landing-prompt/[projectId]/route.ts
File has `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` and `export const maxDuration = 60`
Imports `generateText` from `'ai'` (NOT `generateObject`)
Imports `createVertex` from `'@ai-sdk/google-vertex'`
Imports `NextResponse` from `'next/server'`
Imports `prisma` from `'@/lib/prisma'`
Imports `LANDING_PROMPT_SYSTEM` from `'@/lib/landing-prompt/system-prompt'`
Vertex client initialized with `process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` and location `process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION ?? 'us-central1'`
POST handler signature: `export async function POST(_request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> })`
Loads all messages with `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, select: { role: true, content: true, agentType: true } })`
Returns 422 with `{ error: 'No conversation found for this project.' }` when `dbMessages.length === 0`
Maps messages: role becomes 'user' or 'assistant', content prefixed with `[${m.agentType.toUpperCase()}]: ` when agentType exists
Calls `generateText({ model: vertex('gemini-2.5-flash'), system: LANDING_PROMPT_SYSTEM, messages })`
Returns `NextResponse.json({ prompt: result.text })`
Wraps in try/catch returning `NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 })` on error
Does NOT import `Output`, `z`, or any Zod schema
Accesses `result.text` (NOT `result.output`)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create LandingPromptModal client component
userStories.description: As a student, I want a full-screen HUD-styled modal that auto-triggers prompt generation on open, shows loading/done/error states, and lets me copy or download the generated prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/LandingPromptModal.tsx with `'use client'` directive
Props interface: `{ projectId: string; onClose: () => void }`
Type alias: `type ModalState = 'loading' | 'done' | 'error'`
State: `state` (ModalState, starts 'loading'), `promptText` (string), `copyLabel` (string, starts 'COPY TO CLIPBOARD'), `errorMsg` (string), `abortController` (AbortController | null)
useEffect with empty deps calls `generate()` on mount
`generate()` creates AbortController, calls `fetch('/api/landing-prompt/${projectId}', { method: 'POST', signal: controller.signal })`
On success: parses `{ prompt: string }`, sets promptText and state to 'done'
On non-ok response: parses `{ error?: string }`, sets errorMsg and state to 'error'
On AbortError: calls `onClose()` silently (no error state)
On other catch error: sets errorMsg and state to 'error'
finally: sets abortController to null
`handleCancel` calls `abortController?.abort()` then `onClose()`
`handleCopy` calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText(promptText)`, sets copyLabel to 'COPIED!', resets to 'COPY PROMPT' after 2000ms
`handleDownload` creates Blob with type 'text/markdown', creates object URL, triggers <a> download with filename 'landing-page-prompt.md', revokes URL
`handleRetry` resets state to 'loading', clears errorMsg, calls `generate()`
Modal uses `fixed inset-0 z-50` backdrop with `bg-black/70`
Panel uses HUD theme: `bg-hud-fg border border-hud-panel/30`
Header shows 'LANDING PAGE PROMPT' label and CANCEL button during loading, CLOSE button when done/error
Loading state shows spinner (`animate-spin`) and 'SYNTHESIZING PROMPT FROM ALL CONVERSATIONS...' text
Done state shows instruction banner with COPY TO CLIPBOARD and DOWNLOAD .MD buttons above the prompt
Done state shows promptText in `<pre className='...whitespace-pre-wrap'>` in a scrollable container
Error state shows errorMsg and a RETRY button
Imports `HUDLabel` from `'@/components/hud'`
Exported as `export default function LandingPromptModal`
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire TM+VD milestone gate and landing prompt button into SlidePanel
userStories.description: As a student, I want the CREATE LANDING PAGE button visible in the SlidePanel at all times, enabled only when all Trend Mapper AND Value Designer milestones are complete, opening the LandingPromptModal on click.
acceptanceCriteria: src/components/SlidePanel.tsx imports `computeAgentProgress` from `'@/lib/progress/milestones'`
src/components/SlidePanel.tsx imports `LandingPromptModal` from `'@/components/LandingPromptModal'`
Component has `const [showLandingModal, setShowLandingModal] = useState(false)`
`computeAgentProgress(messages)` is called; result used to find both trend-mapper and value-designer progress
`tmAllComplete` is true when all TM milestones are completed and count > 0
`vdAllComplete` is true when all VD milestones are completed and count > 0
`landingReady = tmAllComplete && vdAllComplete`
The old `if (!relevantSlides || relevantSlides.length === 0) return null` early-return is REMOVED
New guard: `if (!hasSlides && !landingReady) return null` so panel renders when landing is ready even if active agent has no slides
SLIDE EXPORT header section only renders when `hasSlides` is true
Slide buttons only render when `hasSlides && !collapsed`
Button with text 'CREATE LANDING PAGE' renders when `!collapsed`
Button is disabled (cursor-not-allowed, muted colors) when `!landingReady`
Button is enabled (bg-hud-accent text-hud-fg) when `landingReady`
Clicking enabled button calls `setShowLandingModal(true)`
When `!landingReady`, shows helper text 'COMPLETE TM + VD MILESTONES TO UNLOCK' below button
`LandingPromptModal` rendered conditionally when `showLandingModal` is true with `projectId` and `onClose={() => setShowLandingModal(false)}`
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill — confirm button appears, is disabled when milestones incomplete
